cleanup_actions: Unfeatured the birthday video (vault-feature-birthday) after feature-toggle test
Deleted the birthday test video (vault-delete-birthday); vault-progress restored to '1/10 captured · 2 in vault'
Left the original captured state intact: rewards_thanks still captured + Mother's Day Special still featured
critical_code_review_comments: Non-blocking (carried from iter 11): SpinPlay.js still hits /api/maximizer/games (auth-gated) causing 401s in customer's browser console on /spin — same as prior; not related to vault feature.

Non-blocking: ContentDirector.js is now 321 lines and Maximizer.js is 527 lines — both fine, but Maximizer is approaching the 700-line split threshold (games/planner/members/CSV/welcome/RFMD/ledger all in one file).

Minor UX polish: VideoVault.js line 32 fires toast.success 'Saved to your vault' AFTER the vault reload (await load() on line 34 runs before the toast? Actually toast is before load — so toast should fire first). Playwright's wait_for on the toast text timed out at 8s in this run, but the underlying save definitely succeeded (card flipped, progress updated). Sonner default duration is ~4s so the toast likely disappeared before the wait was set up — not a real bug, just noting the test race. Verified via the visible 'Removed from vault' toast in the cleanup screenshot.
Minor: VideoVault.js line 44 uses plain toast() (no variant) for 'Removed from vault' — small inconsistency vs the success/error variants used elsewhere. Cosmetic only.

Nice-to-have: The <video> elements in VideoVault set src={vaultVideoUrl(v.id)} which pulls an auth-open endpoint — good. But they also lack preload='metadata' so 10 captured cards would each start eagerly loading their video on mount. On a slow phone this could be sluggish. Consider preload='none' with a poster image.

context_for_next_testing_agent: 1) VideoVault is imported by ContentDirector.js and renders at the very bottom — always scroll to the end of Content Director to see it. 2) The 10 prompt IDs are exactly: tour, menu_items, kitchen, dining_room, exterior, owner_intro, birthday, holiday, rewards_thanks, new_dish. 3) Upload buttons are <label> elements wrapping hidden <input type='file'> — use input.set_input_files() rather than clicking the label (label's data-testid is vault-upload-<promptId> but the file input is inside it). 4) Campaign upload input has disabled={!!uploading || !customTitle.trim()} — assert via input.is_disabled(). 5) The Feature toggle immediately affects the drip endpoint — check drip-vault-note on Maximizer for the change. 6) welcome-queue ownerVideoUrl is public (no auth required for /api/vault/video/{id}). 7) After any upload test, delete the test video via vault-delete-<promptId> and unfeature if you featured it, to keep vault state clean for next iteration.
